_comment: Defines the visual render order of filterbar building blocks. The orchestrator (create_filter_bar.js) appends ordinary controls to .filter-content-inner in this order, then moves compact controls into .filterbar-panel-body. Chat is now a pinned .filterbar-chat-dock outside the scroll body above the clock bar. Folders marked 'hero_only' are rendered outside contentInner, visible only in the hero container. 'filterbar_engine' contains non-visual utilities and is excluded from the render order.

content_inner_order.label: Title and slogan
content_inner_order.description: h1.morphing-title + p.morphing-subtitle — built inline in create_filter_bar.js

content_inner_order.label: Results count
content_inner_order.description: Shows '46 results' etc. — built inline in create_filter_bar.js

content_inner_order.label: Text search panel
content_inner_order.description: Search input, submit button, location row

content_inner_order.label: Top row buttons
content_inner_order.description: Sort dropdown, reset search, add row button

content_inner_order.label: Admin buttons
content_inner_order.description: View selector, delete selected, column management, embed — rendered inside top_row_buttons via appendAdminFeatures(). Moved to core_components/admin_tools/

content_inner_order.label: Filter sections
content_inner_order.description: Favefox-style always-open field filters, active filter tags, column visibility, legacy filters

content_inner_order.label: Chat UI
content_inner_order.description: Pinned chat dock above the filterbar clock; the whole dock header toggles the animated maximized chat state — appendChatUIIfAllowed() in core_components/admin_tools/admin_button_builder.js

hero_only_order.label: Logo letter grid
hero_only_order.description: Decorative 8-column letter grid — appended to heroContentWrapper, not contentInner

hero_only_order.label: Scroll indicator footer
hero_only_order.description: Footer with pulse-animated scroll button — built inline in create_filter_bar.js

non_visual.label: Non-visual utilities
non_visual.description: fetchTableMeta service, visibility/overlay logic, localStorage helpers
